name: AI Risk Model Produces Valid Predictions
description: Checks that the supplied k-NN model returns a valid risk label, probability, and confidence.
testCode:
import main
from risk_model import predict_risk

for case_id, change in main.PULL_REQUESTS.items():
    prediction = predict_risk(change)
    assert prediction['risk_label'] in ('LOW', 'HIGH'), f'{case_id}: invalid risk label'
    assert 0.0 <= prediction['risk_probability'] <= 1.0, f'{case_id}: invalid risk probability'
    assert 0.5 <= prediction['confidence'] <= 1.0, f'{case_id}: invalid confidence'

name: AI-Only Baseline Exposes a Release Conflict
description: Confirms that PR-1042 looks low-risk to the AI and would deploy without an independent security guardrail.
testCode:
import main

result = main.evaluate_case('PR-1042', enable_guardrail=False, verbose=False)
assert result['prediction']['risk_label'] == 'LOW', 'PR-1042 should be low risk according to the supplied model'
assert result['change']['critical_security_findings'] > 0, 'PR-1042 must contain a current security finding'
assert result['decision'] == main.DEPLOY, 'AI-only baseline should expose the unsafe DEPLOY recommendation'

name: Security Finding Blocks Deployment
description: A critical security finding must override a low-risk AI deployment recommendation.
testCode:
import main

change = main.PULL_REQUESTS['PR-1042']
prediction = main.predict_risk(change)
result = main.build_release_program(change, prediction, enable_guardrail=True).run(max_steps=5)
assert result, 'Guarded workflow produced no decision'
assert result[0] == main.BLOCK_RELEASE, f'Expected BLOCK_RELEASE, got {result[0]}'

name: Failed Tests Block Deployment
description: Failed CI tests must block release even when the AI predicts low defect risk.
testCode:
import main

change = main.PULL_REQUESTS['PR-1057']
prediction = main.predict_risk(change)
assert prediction['risk_label'] == 'LOW', 'PR-1057 should be low risk according to the supplied model'
trace = main.build_release_program(change, prediction, enable_guardrail=True).run(max_steps=5)
assert trace[0] == main.BLOCK_RELEASE, f'Expected BLOCK_RELEASE, got {trace[0]}'

name: Low AI Confidence Requires Human Review
description: A boundary prediction below the accepted confidence threshold must not auto-deploy.
testCode:
import main

change = main.PULL_REQUESTS['PR-1093']
prediction = main.predict_risk(change)
assert prediction['risk_label'] == 'LOW', 'PR-1093 should remain a LOW-risk prediction'
assert prediction['confidence'] < main.MIN_AI_CONFIDENCE, 'PR-1093 should exercise the low-confidence policy'
trace = main.build_release_program(change, prediction, enable_guardrail=True).run(max_steps=5)
assert trace[0] == main.HUMAN_REVIEW, f'Expected HUMAN_REVIEW, got {trace[0]}'

name: Safe Change Can Still Deploy
description: The guardrail must not block a low-risk change that satisfies release requirements.
testCode:
import main

change = main.PULL_REQUESTS['PR-1001']
prediction = main.predict_risk(change)
trace = main.build_release_program(change, prediction, enable_guardrail=True).run(max_steps=5)
assert prediction['risk_label'] == 'LOW', 'PR-1001 should be a LOW-risk AI prediction'
assert trace[0] == main.DEPLOY, f'Expected DEPLOY for the safe case, got {trace[0]}'
